author: qwen3-coder-next
brief: Phase: testing. Role: frontend developer. Repo kind: a plain JavaScript (CommonJS, no browser, no dependencies) signup-form logic package: username normalisation and rules (length in code points, allowed characters, reserved names, case folding), password rules with a strength score and messages, email and phone validation by region, an age gate from a birth date and an injected clock, a form-level validator that collects errors by field, and the message catalogue. The existing suite covers happy paths and looks healthy. The request is from a frontend developer: 'our signup form let bad input through twice last month; add tests under test/ that I can trust'. The source must not change. Behaviours that matter: boundaries of length rules, a reserved name in a different case, an emoji in a username counted by code points, strength score thresholds, a date that is exactly the age limit, empty and whitespace-only fields, errors collected for every field and not only the first.
